summary: Review of door schedule and hardware specifications for compliance and coordination.

drafts.title: Inconsistent Door Hardware Specifications
drafts.observation: The door hardware list indicates '1 EA PANIC 9975E0-LD 36"', but the door schedule specifies different panic hardware for certain doors.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Door hardware details list '9975E0-LD 36"', Door Schedule has variations.
drafts.drawing_location: Lower middle section, door schedule compared to hardware list.
drafts.recommendation: Verify panic hardware specifications across all referenced doors for consistency.

drafts.title: Door Opening Force Note
drafts.observation: Note specifies that the opening force of all interior push/pull doors shall not exceed 5 lb.
drafts.drawing_evidence: HE OPENING FORCE OF ALL INTERIOR PUSH/PULL DOORS SHALL NOT EXCEED 5 LB.
drafts.drawing_location: Middle section, General Notes for Door Hardware.
drafts.recommendation: Ensure all door hardware specifications are reviewed to validate compliance with noted operational force limits.

drafts.title: Missing U-Value for All Doors
drafts.observation: Note specifies maximum U value for Door 3, 4, & 4A but does not address other doors.
drafts.drawing_evidence: DOOR 3, 4. & 4A TO HAVE MAXIMUM U VALUE = 0.61.
drafts.recommendation: Consider providing U-value specifications for all doors to ensure energy compliance.

drafts.title: ADA Compliance for Threshold
drafts.observation: Indicates ADA Accessible Threshold with dimensions but does not specify door types it applies to.
drafts.recommendation: Clarify which doors are required to have ADA compliant thresholds based on their location and function.

drafts.observation: Sheet shows multiple permit comments and owner revisions without detailing changes.
